name: print-social-carousel-lavender-wine-pop-art-masks
title: Lavender wine-tasting carousel with pop-art mask illustrations
whatItIs: A five-tile Instagram grid for a wine-tasting event on a soft lavender background, combining a glossy 3D wine-bottle render, playful pop-art masked-face illustrations, and scattered starburst accents.
whatItMeans: Pairing a photoreal 3D product render with flat pop-art illustrated characters gives an event promo both product desirability and a fun, social event atmosphere in one cohesive palette.
techniques: combine a glossy photoreal 3D render with flat pop-art character illustration in one grid
use a soft pastel background to let saturated purple/yellow accent elements stand out
scatter small starburst/sparkle shapes throughout for a celebratory, event-ready feel

vocabulary.definition: an art style using bold flat colors, hard outlines and mass-media-inspired imagery
